items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: Interviewer mentions Kid Sheik liked people like Chris Kelly; Interviewee does not claim personal interaction or specific professional relationship with Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: Well, you know, they said they started, they started improvising and stuff. Oh yeah, another one you're talking about now. Yeah.

Yeah, how they'd stopped reading and began to improvise. And I finally asked them what year, and it was in the thirties I didn't believe. Yeah. Made it very exciting. Well, I mean, so much research is done on, on bands and nobody ever stops to ask them what style they were playing. And, uh, only recently I was talking to Kid Sheik, who really liked Barrel House trumpet players and was one himself, but he liked people like Chris Kelly, and, uh, Joey Dim in particular, Wooden Joe Nicholas. And, uh, anyhow, uh, I…
I just thought it was an archaic term that was sort of charming, but didn't know what it would signify. And, uh, it's almost as though you didn't have to play, as long as you could read it.
